# Fluenca.ai

> Fluenca is an AI marketing platform: AI agents study your competitors and write your next win, turning a stated goal into ready-to-use insights, content, and campaigns.

## Pages

- [Home](https://fluenca.ai/): How Fluenca's AI agents research, plan, and create for your brand.
- [Agents](https://fluenca.ai/agents): Meet the individual AI agents and what each one handles.
- [Plans](https://fluenca.ai/plans): Simple pricing plans to grow a brand with AI.
- [Book a Demo](https://fluenca.ai/demo): Request a personalized walkthrough of the platform.
- [Contact Sales](https://fluenca.ai/sales): Get a custom plan recommendation from the sales team.
- [Blog](https://fluenca.ai/blog): AI-researched and AI-written blog content.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://fluenca.ai/sitemap.xml): Full list of indexable URLs.
